import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top Products by Revenue
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(8)
axes[0, 0].barh(range(len(product_revenue)), product_revenue.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_yticks(range(len(product_revenue)))
axes[0, 0].set_yticklabels(product_revenue.index)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Top 8 Products by Revenue', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(product_revenue.values):
    axes[0, 0].text(v + 50, i, f'${v:.0f}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group and Payment Method
age_payment = df.groupby(['customer_age_group', 'payment_method'])['total'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_payment = age_payment.reindex(age_order, fill_value=0)
age_payment.plot(kind='bar', ax=axes[0, 1], width=0.8, 
                 color=['#D2691E', '#CD853F', '#DEB887'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Revenue by Age Group and Payment Method', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Payment Method', frameon=True, loc='upper left')
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(age_payment.index, rotation=0)
axes[0, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Takeaway vs Dine-in Analysis
takeaway_data = df.groupby('is_takeaway').agg({'total': 'sum', 'quantity': 'sum'})
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors = ['#A0522D', '#F4A460']
explode = (0.05, 0.05)
axes[1, 0].pie(takeaway_data['total'], labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
               colors=colors, explode=explode, startangle=90,
               textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
axes[1, 0].set_title('Revenue Distribution: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Average Price by Product Size
size_price = df.groupby('size')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
size_order = ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small']
size_price = size_price.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_price.index])
colors_size = ['#654321', '#8B4513', '#A0522D']
bars = axes[1, 1].bar(range(len(size_price)), size_price.values, color=colors_size, edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.5)
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(size_price)))
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(size_price.index, fontsize=11)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Price ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Product Size', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Price by Size', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for i, v in enumerate(size_price.values):
    axes[1, 1].text(i, v + 0.05, f'${v:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
